title: Windows 7 Fails to start as a service, Web command works

labels.name: issue/needs-feedback
labels.description: For bugs, we need more details. For features, the feature must be described in more detail

body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.0.0+193-gea8c8cd
- Git version: 2.8.3
- Operating system: Windows 7
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [ ] Yes (provide example URL)
  - [ ] No
  - [x] Not relevant
- Log gist:
 [...gitea/models/repo.go:154 NewRepoContext()] [E] Fail to set git user.name(exec(2:NewRepoContext(set user.name)) failed: exit status 255 stdout:  stderr: error: could not lock config file /home/SYSTEM/.gitconfig: No such file or directory
): error: could not lock config file /home/SYSTEM/.gitconfig: No such file or directory
## Description
Steps
- Got binary from master on 01st Feb. 
- Installed as a windows service.
- Trying to start windows service 
    - Above log is shown, And gitea service is not started.
- Open `services.msc` locate `gitea` service and click properties.
- Copy `Path to executable`
- Paste it in Command line.
- GitTea service is started normally.

This issue also happens in current binary
...
